NVIDIA Announces GeForce RTX 5090

January 6, 2025

NVIDIA today announced the GeForce RTX 5090, its new flagship graphics card for gamers and creators. The card is built on the Blackwell architecture and will be available starting January 30, 2025, at a price of $1,999.

The GeForce RTX 5090 has 32GB of GDDR7 memory and 21,760 CUDA cores. NVIDIA said the card delivers up to twice the performance of the GeForce RTX 4090 when DLSS 4 with Multi Frame Generation is enabled in supported games.

DLSS 4 introduces Multi Frame Generation, which can generate up to three additional frames for every traditionally rendered frame. NVIDIA said 75 games and apps will support the feature at launch.

The Founders Edition of the card uses a two-slot design with a new double flow-through cooler. Partner cards from ASUS, MSI, Gigabyte and others will also be available on launch day.

The GeForce RTX 5080 will launch on the same day at $999, with 16GB of GDDR7 memory. Laptops with GeForce RTX 50 Series GPUs will be available starting in March.
